Toulouse has twice as many sheep as Charleston, so if Charleston has $ x $ sheep, Toulouse has $ 2x $.  
Charleston has 4 times as many sheep as Seattle, and Seattle has 20 sheep, so Charleston has $ 4 \times 20 = 80 $ sheep.  
Therefore, Toulouse has $ 2 \times 80 = 160 $ sheep.  
Total sheep = Toulouse + Charleston + Seattle = $ 160 + 80 + 20 = 260 $.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 260
